segments.t: 晚上九点左右，随着最后几位邻居回家，庭院又恢复了宁静，汉娜和格雷厄姆在九号房间里叠放着干净的白茶杯，而伊芙琳正轻轻合上胡桃木钢琴的盖子。先听一遍吧。
Not one chipped cup, zero blown fuses, and twenty-four happy neighbors.
You are smiling, Graham! I saw it clearly under the lamp!
Must be a trick of the frosted glass, Hannah.
Hannah, before you close the big paper reservation book tonight...
Is everything all right in Room Four, Miss Evelyn? Did the buzzer ring twice again?
I have grown quite fond of that double ring. Is Room Four free next week?
Wait, you want to extend your stay with us, Miss Evelyn?!
Two more weeks, if you will have me, and I will play every Friday for tea!
Room Four belongs to you as long as you want it, ma'am.
Written in pencil right here! Tessa and Arthur will be thrilled!
Oh, by the way, the mailman slipped a thick foreign postcard into the gate box.
Evening mail on a Friday? Let us take it to the front desk!
现在，让我们一句一句细细回味这段对话。
Not one chipped cup, zero blown fuses, and twenty-four happy neighbors.
「没一个摔缺口的杯子，没烧断一根保险丝，还有二十四位开心的邻居。」 格雷厄姆做出了无懈可击的总结：边缘缺了一角的餐具叫做
chipped cup
而因为过载烧断的保险丝则称为
blown fuses
字面上就是“烧毁的保险丝”。
You are smiling, Graham! I saw it clearly under the lamp!
「你在笑，格雷厄姆！我在灯下看得清清楚楚！」 被当场抓包后，格雷厄姆难得的表情被现在进行时的
You are smiling
突显了出来，接着用副词
clearly
表示清清楚楚、毫无疑问。
Must be a trick of the frosted glass, Hannah.
「那一定是磨砂玻璃产生的错觉，汉娜。」 省略了开头的主语 it，格雷厄姆用
Must be a trick
幽默地为自己解围，随后提到了
frosted glass
灯罩上的磨砂玻璃。
Hannah, before you close the big paper reservation book tonight...
「汉娜，今晚在你合上那本大纸质预订本之前……」 在表示时间的连词后面，如
before you close
英语保持使用一般现在时，即使它指的是未来将要发生的动作。
Is everything all right in Room Four, Miss Evelyn? Did the buzzer ring twice again?
「四号房间一切都好吗，伊芙琳小姐？那个蜂鸣门铃又响了两次吗？」 为了礼貌亲切地询问客人的舒适度，这句问候
Is everything all right
拼写成两个分开的单词：all right。
I have grown quite fond of that double ring. Is Room Four free next week?
「我已经渐渐喜欢上那个双重响铃了。下周四号房空着吗？」 这是一个非常美丽的表达：
have grown quite fond of
描绘了对某样日常事物逐渐产生感情、日久生情的过程。
Wait, you want to extend your stay with us, Miss Evelyn?!
「等等，您想延长您和我们在一起的住宿时间，伊芙琳小姐？！」 任何酒店或客栈都必不可少的表达：
extend your stay
表示延长住宿时间，加上
with us
意思是“和我们在一起，住在我们这里”。
Two more weeks, if you will have me, and I will play every Friday for tea!
「如果您们愿意留我，我就再住两周，并且每个星期五我都来为茶会弹琴！」 充满了古典的礼节，这个条件从句
if you will have me
意思相当于“如果你们愿意接纳我”。
Room Four belongs to you as long as you want it, ma'am.
「只要您需要，四号房间一直属于您，女士。」 从格雷厄姆口中说出的极大赞美：连词
as long as
意思是“只要，只要……就”，最后以尊称
ma'am
收尾，这是 madam 礼貌的缩写形式。
Written in pencil right here! Tessa and Arthur will be thrilled!
「直接拿铅笔写在这儿了！泰莎和阿瑟一定会欣喜若狂的！」 比高兴或快乐还要强烈得多，形容词
thrilled
传达出一种无法抑制的热情：兴奋极了、欣喜若狂！
Oh, by the way, the mailman slipped a thick foreign postcard into the gate box.
「哦，顺便说一下，邮递员往大门信箱里塞进了一张厚厚的外国明信片。」 想要在话语间顺便补充个细节，可以使用
by the way
意思是“顺便说一下”，而在美国，邮递员被称为
mailman
字面意思就是负责邮件的人。
Evening mail on a Friday? Let us take it to the front desk!
「星期五的晚班邮件？咱们把它拿到前台去吧！」 为了表达对一个不寻常的星期五的惊讶，这里在星期前面加上了不定冠词：
on a Friday
“在一个星期五！” 让我们重新流畅地听一遍整个场景。
Not one chipped cup, zero blown fuses, and twenty-four happy neighbors.
You are smiling, Graham! I saw it clearly under the lamp!
Must be a trick of the frosted glass, Hannah.
Hannah, before you close the big paper reservation book tonight...
Is everything all right in Room Four, Miss Evelyn? Did the buzzer ring twice again?
I have grown quite fond of that double ring. Is Room Four free next week?
Wait, you want to extend your stay with us, Miss Evelyn?!
Two more weeks, if you will have me, and I will play every Friday for tea!
Room Four belongs to you as long as you want it, ma'am.
Written in pencil right here! Tessa and Arthur will be thrilled!
Oh, by the way, the mailman slipped a thick foreign postcard into the gate box.
Evening mail on a Friday? Let us take it to the front desk!
伊芙琳留下来成为了九号房间每周五的钢琴师，而且大门信箱里还躺着一张迟来的明信片！第二季的最后一场戏了——让我们听听吧。
See you soon!
